description.zh:
带宽值，单位Kbps。
>该参数暂未开放使用。
description.en:
The bandwidth. Unit: Kbps.

> This parameter is not available.

description.zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见[如何保证幂等性](~~25693~~)。
description.en: A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a unique value for this parameter from your client. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~25693~~).

description.zh: 一致性组的描述信息。长度为2~256个英文或中文字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头。
description.en: The description of the replication pair-consistent group. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

description.zh:
是否开启复制时间控制（RTC）。取值范围：

- false：关闭。
- true：开启。

> 如果设置为ture，表示一致性组开启复制时间控制（RTC），加入该一致性组的异步复制对均开启RTC。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable replication time control (RTC). Valid values:

- false: RTC is disabled.

- true: RTC is enabled.

> If this parameter is set to true, RTC is enabled for the replication pair-consistent group. RTC is also enabled for all asynchronous replication pairs that are added to the group.

description.zh: 一致性复制组名称。长度为2~128个英文或中文字符。必须以大小写字母或中文开头，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者短划线（-）。
description.en: The name of the replication pair-consistent group. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. The name can contain digits, colons (:), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).

description.zh: 一致性组设定的RPO值，单位：秒。当前仅支持900秒。
description.en: The recovery point objective (RPO) of the replication pair-consistent group. Unit: seconds. A value of 900 is supported.

description.zh: 一致性复制组所属的地域ID。
description.en: The region ID of the replication pair-consistent group.

description.zh: 一致性复制组ID。您可以调用[DescribeDiskReplicaGroups](~~426614~~)查询一致性复制组ID。
description.en: The ID of the replication pair-consistent group. Call [DescribeDiskReplicaGroups](~~426614~~) to query the IDs of replication pair-consistent groups.

descriptions.zh:
## 接口说明

- 一致性复制组功能支持的地域请参见[云盘异步复制概述](~~314563~~)。

- 一致性复制组必须处于**已创建**（`created`）或者**已停止**（`stopped`）状态。
descriptions.en:
## Description

- For information about the regions that support the replication pair-consistent group feature, see [Overview of asynchronous replication](~~314563~~).

- The replication pair-consistent group must be in the **Created** (`created`) or **Stopped** (`stopped`) state.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ebs modify-disk-replica-group --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --replica-group-id pg-myreplica0000 --group-name myreplicagrouptest --description This_is_description. --rpo 900 --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --bandwidth 1 --enable-rtc true --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ebs ModifyDiskReplicaGroup --region cn-hangzhou --GroupName myreplicagrouptest --RPO 900 --Description 'This_is_description.' --EnableRtc true --Bandwidth 1 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ReplicaGroupId 'pg-myreplica0000' --ClientToken '123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000'
